categories.main_business_segments: Zhejiang EV-Tech Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the new energy vehicle (NEV) sector, focusing on the research, development, production, and sales of NEV onboard power products such as onboard chargers (OBC), DC/DC converters, power distribution units (PDU), integrated onboard power products, and deep integration products. The company also develops non-onboard products including liquid-cooled ultra-fast charging power modules and intelligent DC charging pile power modules, along with providing technical services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes proprietary R&D with a focus on power electronics conversion technology, digital and modular software development, efficient thermal management, and structural design. It applies advanced semiconductor materials like silicon carbide (SiC) and gallium nitride (GaN) to enhance power density and efficiency. Production follows a sales-driven, customer order-based model with automated and digital manufacturing lines ensuring quality and efficiency. The R&D process integrates technology pre-research, platform development, and project development stages.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include domestic traditional automakers and new energy vehicle startups such as GAC Group, NIO, XPeng, Xiaomi Auto, and international brands like Renault and Stellantis. The company serves the NEV industry, providing core components to first-tier automakers and high-end brands, with a growing presence in overseas markets, especially Europe.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Huzhou, Zhejiang Province. It has established subsidiaries and production facilities in Hangzhou, Guangzhou, Anji, France, Singapore, Hong Kong, and Thailand, supporting both domestic and international markets. Overseas sales accounted for approximately 6.8% of revenue in 2024.
categories.supply_chain_position: Zhejiang EV-Tech operates in the midstream segment of the NEV supply chain, specializing in core component manufacturing for electric vehicles, particularly in battery charging and power management systems. It collaborates closely with upstream semiconductor suppliers and downstream vehicle manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes long-term technology leadership through sustained R&D investment, focusing on high integration, high voltage platforms (400V/800V), and multi-functional bidirectional charging technologies (V2L, V2G, V2V). It pursues platform-based and customized product development, advances digitalization and automation in manufacturing, and expands into non-onboard digital energy solutions. Strategic partnerships with semiconductor firms like Infineon enhance innovation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of NEV onboard and non-onboard power products to vehicle manufacturers and related enterprises. The company also earns income from technical services. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales contracts, with some consignment sales arrangements.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading third-party supplier of NEV power components in China, ranking among the top domestic suppliers. It competes with other specialized NEV component manufacturers and aims to strengthen its foothold in international markets by supplying to global first-tier automakers and premium brands.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Zhejiang EV-Tech reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.93 billion, a 5.38% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 94.6 million. The company has shown steady growth in production and sales volumes, with a significant increase in assets and equity following its IPO in 2024. R&D expenses accounted for over 10% of revenue, reflecting a strong commitment to innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes advanced technology leadership, high product integration, and customization capabilities to meet diverse customer needs. Its products feature high conversion efficiency, power density, reliability, and compliance with international standards. The integration of multiple power modules reduces vehicle space and cost, enhancing overall vehicle performance. The company’s strong R&D and testing infrastructure, along with strategic partnerships, underpin its competitive edge.
